original_gold_eval_defects.finding: Original gold_eval private atomic gold cue statuses had no enforced bidirectional reviewed_cues to atomic_gold_claims trace; cue could lie NO_ATOM and still be scored.
original_gold_eval_defects.action: Fixed in ire/v6/gold_traceability.py and gold_eval.py before TP/FP/FN diagnostic; requires gold_atom_ids per cue, exact bidirectional indexed refs.

original_gold_eval_defects.finding: Original scoring path permanently assigns production_gold_certified=False even on signed evidence; no admitted production positive evaluation route.
original_gold_eval_defects.action: Introduced separate production-only positive release contract in ire/v6/gold_release.py; dormant until preregistered host public-key registry and two real signed source-only reviews, consensus and post-gold alignment are supplied. Current gold_eval remains diagnostics only.

original_gold_eval_defects.finding: Caller-supplied three public keys plus signatures on a summary could appear attested without verified separate source-only review sessions.
original_gold_eval_defects.action: Production evaluator uses immutable code-pinned registry SHA, signed individual reviewer and neutral-host receipts for two distinct source-only sessions, full source-linked draft ledgers, signed consensus, and host-signed later alignment; user payload alone cannot enroll trust keys.

original_gold_eval_defects.finding: Reviewer semantic match_dimension booleans were accepted without trusted post-gold adjudicator attestation.
original_gold_eval_defects.action: Gold-release requires neutral-host signed gold-to-prediction alignment after gold freeze. Boolean semantic conclusions are still judgments, not independently provable by a string matcher.

original_gold_eval_defects.finding: Real independent reviewer submissions/consensus do not exist; source-first71 same-chat is diagnostically useful but not blind independent ground truth.
original_gold_eval_defects.action: Keep actual precision, recall and high-risk FN NULL. Requires two independently isolated source-only reviewer records, disputes resolved, and verifiable host signing; no ChatGPT API and no external human reviewer fabricated.

next_safely_executable_action: Two actual source-only independently isolated ChatGPT reviewer submissions with verifiable host provenance, then consensus, then pinned signed gold-to-frozen-prediction alignment and real thresholds; do not relabel existing same-chat 71 as gold.
